_about: Each claim is something the launch copy says works on Windows. A claim counts as proven only when every parity row listed for it is marked 'run on Windows' in windows-parity.md. 'core' claims are the ones the launch can't happen without; the rest are left out of the copy (and listed as 'not on Windows yet') until proven.

hotkey.label: One key: hold to dictate, double-tap to talk

dictation.label: Dictation into any app, on your own PC

toolbar.label: The toolbar, with a dot for each agent

inbox.label: The Inbox: questions, plans, Allow/Deny and finished work

talk.label: Talk: say it and Cadence sends it to the right agent

claude.label: Claude Code agents, hosted by Cadence

herdr.label: Codex, Gemini and other CLIs through herdr

worktrees.label: A git worktree per agent, with Diff and History

sets.label: Sets: put a group of agents away

judgment.label: Your judgment: Cadence learns how you decide

pro.label: Cadence Pro: answering for you, away mode, long runs

iphone.label: The iPhone app, paired with your PC
